module origen_099915(
    input wire clock,
    input wire data_in,
    output reg [2:0] data
);

reg [10:0] current;
reg [7:0] stored;
reg [7:0] prev;
reg [3:0] count;
reg started;
reg parity;

always @(negedge clock) begin
    if (!data_in && !started) begin
        started <= 1;
        count <= 0;
        parity <= 0;
    end
    else if (started) begin
        current[count] <= data_in;
        if (count > 0 && count <= 8)
            parity <= parity ^ data_in;
        count <= count + 1;

        if (count == 11) begin
            if (parity == current[9]) begin
                prev <= stored;
                stored <= current[8:1];
            end
            current <= 0;
            count <= 0;
            started <= 0;
            parity <= 0;
        end
    end
end

always @(*) begin
    if (prev != 8'hF0) begin
        case (stored)
            8'h1D: data = 3'd3;
            8'h1C: data = 3'd1;
            8'h1B: data = 3'd4;
            8'h23: data = 3'd2;
            default: data = 3'd0;
        endcase
    end
    else begin
        data = 3'd0;
    end
end

endmodule
